daily_logs.summary: Continued device inventory and label work, and helped move the MaintainX Label Generator from local use to server use.
details: Continued work around physical device tracking and labeling.
Worked with service room devices and asset label needs.
Participated in the MaintainX Label Generator workflow built by the manager.
The original label process required manual lookup, copying fields, preparing label content, and printing.
The new Label Generator used MaintainX API data to automatically fetch label related information.
Helped deploy the tool from local running to a shared server environment so other team members could use it.
The work connected physical asset inventory, MaintainX records, API automation, and server deployment.
daily_logs.impact: Supported about 50 labels and helped reduce repeated manual label preparation by an estimated 75% to 95%. Manager feedback was very positive.
